description: This file defines an interface (abstract class) 'ISubscriptionHandler' for managing subscriptions in a server context, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, publishing, and thread management. It is part of a larger codebase related to VSS (Vehicle Signal Specification) database handling and server-side subscription management.

classes.name: ISubscriptionHandler
classes.description: An interface for handling subscriptions within the system, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, publishing, and thread control.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a new subscription based on a channel, database, path, and attribute.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscription identified by a subscription ID.

methods.name: unsubscribeAll
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions associated with a given channel.

methods.name: publishForVSSPath
methods.description: Publishes data for a specific VSS path with associated datatype, attribute, and value.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the server instance.

methods.name: startThread
methods.description: Starts the internal thread for processing subscriptions or related tasks.

methods.name: isThreadRunning
methods.description: Checks if the internal thread is running.

methods.name: subThreadRunner
methods.description: Function for the thread runner, returns a void pointer.

methods.name: addPublisher
methods.description: Adds a publisher object to the subscription handler.
